W2 (empirical), after E049. The tip is E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 on seeds 0-2. It is E036 plus the group-2 freeze (last 10% of steps) plus a 0.25 epoch top-up. Identical-code reruns of E036 (0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497, 0.7544; times 5.29-5.34) show rebuild noise of about 0.3 pp on a 3-seed mean and about ±0.03 s on time. The population mean is about 0.752, so headroom over the 0.75 bar is about 0.2 pp.

Mechanisms and their support:
1. Epoch dial: about 5% of time per 0.5 epoch for 0.0-0.25 pp (E020, E023, E027). The top-up in E049 appears to have kept accuracy at 0.7535 while the freeze saved time.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon (+0.66 pp, confounded, E006) are in the tip. More than 10 time-neutral boosters failed (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd, LS). The averaging, LR and wd optimum is flat within about 0.2 pp.
3. Time tracks pixels. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Trimming steps or samples costs about as much as the dial, roughly 1.5-2.3 s/pp (E031, E040, E041, E048, E045).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). It is bandwidth-heavy. A group-2 freeze saves about 0.2-0.25 s at roughly neutral accuracy. E037 (60% freeze) is the cliff, at -0.38 pp. E039 and E042 saved only 0.03-0.05 s.
5. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (135 ms, E047). Identical-math systems work can recover maybe half of it, about 1% (E035 saved about 0.07 s from prepare work).
6. Noise: 3-seed std is about 0.15-0.2 pp. Any RNG or step-count change reshuffles it. Rebuilds reselect kernels.

Misses: I under-predicted the savings of cuts and freezes (E046, E048). E043 was rebuild noise. I over-predicted time-neutral boosters.

Unsure: whether the E049 saving is real under same-build comparison. Whether it transfers to the PCIe judge. Whether ReLU gives more than 3%. Whether I080's stride-2 conv loses accuracy (it removes the max-pool nonlinearity). Whether the cascade can go further without hitting a cliff.

forecasts.reason: Systems-only change saves maybe 1% (~0.05 s) with identical math; accuracy moves only by rebuild noise.
ReLU likely saves 1-3% of time and costs a few hundredths of a pp to 0.2 pp. A 3% gain and a 0.15 pp loss together are unlikely.
Dropping cudagraphs on every variant likely costs more than 0.5% time; the diagnostic may show reproducibility but not a keepable recipe.
The stride-2 conv drops the full-resolution 31x31 activation and pool (a large bandwidth saving, maybe 4-6%), but losing the max-pool nonlinearity may cost accuracy.
Selection plus top-up is roughly on the dial's line, so it will be a wash within noise.
Moving the freeze from 90% to 85% saves about 0.1 s; the accuracy cost is uncertain and near the E037 cliff side.

cruxes: Is E049's time saving versus E036 real in a same-build pairing, and does its 20-seed mean stay within 0.03 pp? This decides whether the cascade plus top-up becomes the base.
Does removing the 31x31 conv-then-pool (I080) or GELU (I078) cut memory-bound step time by more than 3% at under 0.15 pp accuracy cost?
Is rebuild kernel-reselection noise (about 0.3 pp on 3 seeds) removable? If not, no sub-0.15 pp keep decision is reliable.
